The '''Juriod fang-flier''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of creature<ref name="PSG" /> native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jurio]].<ref name="Planet" /> When being transported as cargo aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]], they were required to be frozen which induced a state of dormancy in them.<ref name="PSG" />
